# ended at time

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:endedAtTime`](gmeow-endedAtTime.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/endedAtTime>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
